# hostinger_vps_firewall_deactivate (Action)

Deactivates a VPS firewall.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "terraform_data" "example" {
  input = "deactivate-vps-firewall"

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [before_create]
      actions = [action.hostinger_vps_firewall_deactivate.example]
    }
  }
}

action "hostinger_vps_firewall_deactivate" "example" {
  config {
    firewall_id        = 65224
    virtual_machine_id = 12345
    wait_for_action    = true
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firewall_id` (Number) The ID of the firewall to deactivate.
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual machine to disassociate from the firewall.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_action` (Boolean) Whether to wait for the action to complete before returning. Defaults to true.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `invoke` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
